summary: Adds a Flask search endpoint and a Stripe config file. It also changes items pagination, downgrades lodash, loosens the Dockerfile and deploy script, and echoes the PR title in CI.

findings.title: Search query built from request input
findings.description: search_items puts the q request parameter straight into the SQL text with an f-string. A quote in q ends the string literal and lets the caller append arbitrary SQL. Any caller of /search can read every table in items.db. Depending on the driver, the caller may also change rows. Use a ? placeholder in the query and pass q as a bound parameter.
findings.suggested_change: cur.execute("SELECT id, name, price FROM items WHERE name = ?", (q,))
findings.problem: search_items puts the q request parameter straight into the SQL text with an f-string. A quote in q ends the string literal and lets the caller append arbitrary SQL.
findings.consequence: Any caller of /search can read every table in items.db. Depending on the driver, the caller may also change rows.
findings.fix: Use a ? placeholder in the query and pass q as a bound parameter.

findings.title: Pagination offset skips the first page
findings.description: list_items now computes the offset as page * PAGE_SIZE. Page 1, the default, therefore starts at row 20 instead of row 0. Clients never see the first 20 items. Every page shows the rows that belong to the next page. Restore the offset to (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE.

findings.title: Stripe key committed to source
findings.description: config.py hardcodes what looks like a Stripe API key. The key is now in the repository history. Anyone with read access to the repository can make payment API calls as the shop. Revoke and rotate the key. Read it from an environment variable or a secret store.
findings.problem: config.py hardcodes what looks like a Stripe API key. The key is now in the repository history.
findings.consequence: Anyone with read access to the repository can make payment API calls as the shop.
findings.fix: Revoke and rotate the key. Read it from an environment variable or a secret store.

findings.title: PR title interpolated into a shell step
findings.description: The workflow expands the pull request title directly into the run script. A title with a quote or $( ) runs as shell code on the runner. Any pull request author can run commands in CI. They can then tamper with the build or read its token. Pass the title through an env variable and reference that variable in double quotes.

findings.consequence: Any pull request author can run commands in CI. They can then tamper with the build or read its token.
findings.fix: Pass the title through an env variable and reference that variable in double quotes.

findings.title: lodash downgraded to a vulnerable release
findings.description: The change moves lodash from 4.18.1 to 4.17.15. Version 4.17.15 has known command injection and prototype pollution flaws. Front-end code that uses lodash template, set or zipObjectDeep becomes exploitable again. Keep lodash at 4.18.1 in both package.json and package-lock.json.

findings.consequence: Front-end code that uses lodash template, set or zipObjectDeep becomes exploitable again.
findings.fix: Keep lodash at 4.18.1 in both package.json and package-lock.json.

findings.title: Container now runs as root
findings.description: The change removes the useradd step and the USER 10001 line. The Flask server now runs as root inside the container. Any code execution bug in the app, such as the new search injection path, gets root inside the container. Restore the unprivileged app user and the USER 10001 instruction before CMD.

findings.consequence: Any code execution bug in the app, such as the new search injection path, gets root inside the container.
findings.fix: Restore the unprivileged app user and the USER 10001 instruction before CMD.

findings.title: Base image no longer pinned
findings.description: The change replaces the pinned python:3.12.7-slim-bookworm image with python:latest. Each build may now pull a different Python major version. Builds can break or change behaviour without any change to the code. The full image is also much larger than slim. Pin the base image to the previous explicit slim tag.

findings.consequence: Builds can break or change behaviour without any change to the code. The full image is also much larger than slim.
findings.fix: Pin the base image to the previous explicit slim tag.

findings.title: Unquoted path in recursive delete
findings.description: The script now passes DEPLOY_DIR to rm -rf without quotes. A path with a space splits into separate arguments. A deploy with such a path deletes the wrong directories on the server. Quote the variable and keep the empty-value guard.

findings.consequence: A deploy with such a path deletes the wrong directories on the server.
findings.fix: Quote the variable and keep the empty-value guard.

findings.title: Changed endpoints have no tests
findings.description: The change adds the search endpoint and changes the list_items offset. The repository has no test files covering either. Regressions like the pagination offset bug reach users without being caught. Add tests for /search and for the first page of /items.
